thread:
Maria_CS: kicking off a quick thread for Seashell capacity bring-up — want to capture the quota probe plan and ops readout so we can hand to sales before EOW
Jake_SRE: noted. what target TPS/QPS are we planning for the probe? 
Elena_Seashell: FYI Seashell expects 120 rps steady, with 400 rps 90th percentile bursts during marketing windows. goal is no more than 200ms p50 and <800ms p95.
Ravi_MLE: based on their prompt mix and sequence len distribution, recommend model m-redwood-3b-q4f and 2x dedicated slots initially. KV cache hit expected ~35% so effective token load lower.
Sam_CS: action items: 1) confirm reserved quota numbers with billing 2) run shadow replay of last 48h traffic 3) run two staged loadtests (smoke + sustained).
Maria_CS: billing confirmed tentative quota 16k tokens/sec (we'll convert to requests in the plan). Sam please add the ticket to the onboarding board. @Elena_Seashell can you confirm which org keys to include in the shadow run?
Elena_Seashell: will provide keys tomorrow morning, can redact PII.
Jake_SRE: load test plan draft ->

- smoke: 5m ramp to 150 rps, validate latency SLOs and error rates
- soak: 60m at 120 rps steady with 30m of 350 rps bursts (180s bursts, every 20m)
- chaos: optional short GPU drain to validate fallback to smaller model

Script examples:
```
# workload replay (locally)
python tools/load_replay.py --input seashell_48h.json --rate 120 --burst 350 --duration 3600
# wrk3 sketch
wrk -t8 -c200 -d60s --latency http://staging.redwood/api/generate
```

Ravi_MLE: add a metric: model variant fallback count and avg tokens-per-request. we'll track prompt-level error signatures too.
Sam_CS: I'll schedule the smoke tomorrow 10:00 PT and soak on Thursday 02:00 PT (off-peak for them). tagging @ci-bot to create the ephemeral test env.
ci-bot: ephemeral-env created -> redwood-stg-seashell-2024-11-09, logs forwarded to #eng-runtime.
Jake_SRE: pre-flight checklist: key/cert rotations, KMS access, VPC peering validated, autoscale policy set to min=2 max=8, scale step=1 per 30s. confirm autoscale step with customer?
Elena_Seashell: min=2 max=10 preferred. we want headroom for ad-hoc spikes.
Maria_CS: noted. we need to capture renewal risk signal: they flagged a potential budget cap next quarter. Sam, can you run a cost delta estimate for m-redwood-3b-q4f vs m-redwood-2b-int8 for them and add to QBR notes.
Sam_CS: on it, will post numbers after soak results.
Ravi_MLE: if cost delta is large, propose try quantized 2b with caching enabled as fallback — probably <10% quality difference on their eval set.
Maria_CS: capture feedback loop: run a short prompt eval set (20 representative prompts) pre- and post-loadtest to detect regressions. log results in the onboarding doc.
Elena_Seashell: agree. also sharing two high-priority prompts that must be zero-tolerance for hallucination.
Jake_SRE: after soak, we'll produce a one-page ops readout: peak QPS, p50/p95 latency, error %, autoscale events timeline, fallback occurrences, and recommendations. sending draft to #customer-success for review.
Sam_CS: adding a quick checklist for enablement call with their platform team: VPC walkthrough, API key rotation, observability links, runbook handoff.
Maria_CS: perfect — final ask: everyone, please update the onboarding board card with your sign-off (smoke done, soak scheduled, readout pending). I'll compile and share with sales/AM before Friday 3pm PT. :thumbsup:
Elena_Seashell: thanks team, appreciate the clear plan. we'll be on standby for the keys and a 10:00 PT check-in tomorrow.
Jake_SRE: acked. I'll be in the 10:00 slot to kick smoke and watch autoscale.
Ravi_MLE: will monitor model perf and push alerts for token-rate anomalies.
ci-bot: recorded action: ephemeral-env teardown scheduled for 2024-11-10T08:00:00Z
Maria_CS: closing thread for now — will reopen with post-smoke notes.
